name: Barbed Devil
summary: A spiny devil that claws, lashes with its tail, and hurls flame.

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.text: At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals {dmg:1d10:piercing} to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {ref:glossary/hit-points} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or it makes two Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=13}) from both claws.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.onHit: If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.
